segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making time. I wanted to confirm the May 20 go-live and the seat count before I send the order form for signature.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re at 46 full users and 12 read-only. Finance asked me to keep the first-year invoice under $38,000 if possible.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. Based on the pricing sheet, 46 full users plus 12 read-only on the annual plan comes to $36,720 before tax. That includes standard onboarding and the two admin training sessions.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that should work. Is onboarding still the week of May 6? We need the billing team trained before they start entering June renewals.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. I have May 7 at 11 a.m. Central for admins, and May 9 at 2 p.m. Central for the billing team. If you want, we can add a 30-minute Q&A on May 14 at no charge.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, let’s add the Q&A. Contract term is still 12 months, right? Our legal team doesn’t want auto-renewal longer than one year.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, 12-month initial term, then it renews annually unless either side gives 30 days’ notice. Payment terms are net 30, and the invoice can reference PO 4178.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send it to me and copy Marcus in procurement. If the totals match what you just said, I can sign by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send the order form with the $36,720 annual total, 46 full users, 12 read-only, May 20 go-live, and PO 4178 referenced.
